description: Generate ONE AI package resource of a video — eBook, mind map or quiz — in one or more languages, with its settings and extra instructions (same as the dashboard: Video Settings → Panda AI). PAID: 1 credit per minute of video per language (minimum 1 min; a partial minute counts only past 1 s), e.g. a 10-minute video in 2 languages = 20 credits. On an active Gold/Enterprise plan the free daily AI quota covers the whole request while it lasts (1 use per request, checked before sending). Languages that already have this resource, or are still generating, are skipped (listed in skipped); the balance is checked before sending. The resource is ready in a few minutes; follow it with panda_get_ai_workflows. Returns {video_id, resource, from_lang, to_langs, skipped, gross_cost_credits, cost_credits, free_by_daily_quota, response}; response is the queued request (its id isn't a work id: the works show up in panda_get_ai_workflows once processed). To redo an existing one use panda_regenerate_ai_resource.

custom_instructions.description: Extra instructions for the AI (up to 1000 characters)

ebook_config.description: eBook only: layout, fonts, colors, format, header/footer, logo

header_footer.description: Header and footer on the pages

logo_key.description: Logo: the logo_key returned by panda_get_ai_ebook_upload_url (kind=logo) after the file was sent; null removes the logo

from_lang.description: Spoken language of the video. Default: the video's original language, else 'auto'

image_generation_count.description: eBook only: AI images in the eBook (dashboard offers 0, 3, 5 or 10; default 10)

quiz_config.description: Quiz only: questions, options per question and quiz options

to_langs.description: Languages to generate in, e.g. ['pt-BR','en']. Default: the video's language

name: panda_generate_ai_resource
title: Generate AI Resource
